opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants - Autumn Round

amount.raw: The maximum grant available in this category is £20,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Non-profit organisations for exhibitions, exhibition catalogues, commissions, conferences, research, non-commercial publications and the development of collections through acquisitions, conservation, cataloguing and display.
opportunities.summary: Henry Moore Grants support the growth and development of sculpture across historical, modern and contemporary registers, and funds research that expands the appreciation of sculpture.
